question: What is Australia's current legal and operating perimeter for virtual assets, digital-asset and tokenised-custody platforms, stablecoins, tokenised bank money and CBDC, and where do finality and loss remain?
bluf: Australia's existing-law transition reached an enforcement hinge on 30 September: ASIC reported more than 45 digital-asset-related licence applications, but applications are not licences, and firms needing authority that did not satisfy the no-action conditions risk breach from 1 October. The future DAP/TCP regime remains enacted but uncommenced. On 30 September ANZ, BHP, Citi and Swift also completed a live Melbourne-New York USD corporate-treasury transaction using tokenized deposits behind BHP's ordinary ANZ account channel. This is stronger than Project Acacia's bounded research but does not disclose value, final-system records, recurring volume or exceptions. CBA, NAB and Westpac remain at different proof, working-group and product states. RITS Exchange Settlement Account entries remain the production final-money anchor; no clear public-interest case for retail CBDC has been established.

authority.summary: Parliament and Treasury own the statutory framework; ASIC applies corporations, markets and financial-services law and will license DAPs and TCPs; AUSTRAC registers VASPs and enforces AML/CTF duties; APRA supervises prudentially regulated institutions; the RBA and Payments System Board own central-bank settlement and payment-system functions; the ATO applies tax law.
authority.boundary: Legislation, financial-services licensing, AML registration, prudential supervision, payment-system operation and tax treatment are different capacities.

legal_objects.summary: The record separates virtual assets under the AML/CTF perimeter; digital assets that may already be securities, managed investments, derivatives or non-cash payment facilities; future DAP and TCP financial products; stablecoins; tokenised commercial-bank deposits; pilot wholesale CBDC or tokenised reserves; ESA balances; and a possible retail CBDC.
legal_objects.boundary: Cryptographic form does not merge a platform contract, underlying token, bank deposit, stablecoin, central-bank reserve or CBDC.

permitted_activities.summary: AUSTRAC registration covers designated exchange, virtual-asset exchange, safekeeping, transfer and offer-or-sale services for AML purposes. Current ASIC law depends on the financial-product and service facts. The future DAF regime creates platform and custody licensing, standards, rules and disclosure; Project Acacia activity occurred under bounded research arrangements and regulatory relief.
permitted_activities.boundary: AML registration, AFSL authority, class relief, no-action treatment and pilot participation do not confer the same permissions.

entry_gates.summary: A business may need AUSTRAC enrolment and VASP registration, an AFSL or authorization under current law, market or clearing and settlement authority, APRA-regulated bank status, or later DAP and TCP authorisations. ASIC's conditional no-action deadline was extended to 30 September 2026. RITS and ESA access are separate from product and platform licensing.
entry_gates.boundary: Application, registration, licence, relief, bank status, ESA access, technical onboarding and first transaction are separate gates.

named_operating_actors.summary: ANZ, BHP, Citi and Swift are named in the live September USD route. Project Acacia separately identifies ANZ, CBA, NAB and Westpac across proof, working-group and collaboration roles: ANZ led bond and trade-payable PoCs; CBA led an intraday-repo PoC; Westpac led a PayTo/tokenized-term-deposit PoC; NAB and all four banks joined the Deposit Token Working Group. AP+, Austraclear, ASX, HQLAX, Kinexys and several private-money issuers own different infrastructure and settlement records.
named_operating_actors.boundary: Bank group, issuing legal entity, corporate customer, platform, token issuer, CSD, ledger and final-settlement institution are not interchangeable.

claims_and_backing.summary: Project Acacia deliberately tested different money claims: existing ESA balances, a pilot RBA wholesale CBDC, tokenised commercial-bank deposits and stablecoins. A tokenised deposit remains a bank liability; a digitally native tokenised reserve would be an RBA liability if issued; a digital-twin reserve would represent segregated ESA balances. The future DAF platform contract does not itself make an underlying token sovereign or guaranteed.
claims_and_backing.boundary: Issuer, reserve or balance-sheet backing, client asset, token state and final settlement asset must be identified separately.

domestic_rails.summary: RITS supplies high-value and feeder-system settlement in central-bank money; settlement is final and irrevocable when paying and receiving members' ESAs are simultaneously debited and credited. FSS supports fast retail settlement through the NPP feeder. Project Acacia coordinated bounded tokenised transactions through several settlement models; September consultation asks how RITS and FSS should support future tokenised finance.
domestic_rails.boundary: Token or trade completion does not prove ESA finality, and RITS finality does not settle every upstream title, custody or customer claim.

cross_border_routes.summary: ANZ, BHP, Citi and Swift completed live USD corporate-treasury payments between Melbourne and New York using tokenized deposits while the customer retained its ordinary ANZ account and channel. Swift's general architecture uses bank-specific tokenized-deposit records and a shared orchestration ledger before final settlement through existing systems. Swift later reported aggregate use across six continents and five currencies. The notices do not disclose value, exact legal entities, correspondent or reserve accounts, FX, final-system entries, beneficiary-credit time, recurring volume or exceptions.
cross_border_routes.boundary: First live cross-border use and a multicontinent aggregate are not a complete recurring production route; shared-ledger orchestration is not the final central-bank or correspondent-money record.

operating_state.summary: The AML/VASP perimeter and current financial-services law are effective; the ASIC no-action filing deadline has passed with more than 45 applications; the DAF platform and custody regime remains future-dated. ANZ's USD Swift-ledger route is a live transaction, while A$DC has one bounded 2022 mint-transfer-redemption record. Acacia is completed research: ANZ, CBA and Westpac use cases were PoCs, and NAB's named role was working-group or collaboration. RITS tokenization remains consultation and retail CBDC unissued.
operating_state.boundary: Application, no-action reliance, enacted-future regime, one live transaction, one-off bank stablecoin event, PoC, consultation and general production are distinct states.

scale.summary: ASIC reported more than 45 digital-asset-related licence applications since the October 2025 INFO 225 update. Project Acacia had 57 industry participants and 20 use cases. ANZ's 2022 A$DC event minted A$30 million, while the September 2026 ANZ route has no disclosed value. The RBA survey found about 2 percent of respondents used cryptocurrency for a payment in the prior year. None of these measures is national token circulation, custody assets, market volume or recurring bank-token throughput.
scale.boundary: Applications, participants, use cases, one-off issuance, one undisclosed-value route and survey persons measure different populations and cannot be summed.

stress.summary: AUSTRAC reported 45 cancellations, suspensions or refused renewals across remittance and VASP registrations in the preceding year for mixed reasons including inactivity, insolvency, capacity and financial-crime risk, without a VASP-only split. No national stablecoin run, customer-asset recovery, exchange failure or stressed tokenised-settlement result is established.
stress.boundary: Supervisory action is not a count of crypto insolvencies or customer losses, and normal-operation resilience controls are not observed tokenised-market stress.

correction_and_loss.summary: RITS rules protect final ESA settlement against zero-hour unwinding and provide member suspension and default procedures. The future DAF regime authorizes asset-holding and transactional and settlement standards, contemplates client-money trust treatment and permits omnibus token locations when internal accounting identifies clients. Actual customer recovery still depends on final standards, firm licence, platform rules, custody terms and insolvency law.
correction_and_loss.boundary: RITS payment finality, platform accounting, asset segregation, restitution, issuer redemption and government or deposit protection are different remedies.

evidence_boundary.summary: This record is refreshed through 13:25:37 EDT on 1 October 2026 and incorporates the 30 September ASIC and ANZ events. Bank notices establish participant and transaction claims but do not expose underlying account, correspondent, final-system or exception records. The Federal Register and ASIC still differ by one day on April 2027 DAF commencement. No current bank-primary receipt was located for general CBA retail crypto, NAB AUDN production or a Westpac public token.
evidence_boundary.boundary: A bounded primary-source pass establishes the public record at cutoff, not confidential transactions, later licence decisions or permanent absence.
